Our Expertise in Power BI Development

<01>

Power BI Assistance & Strategy

Our experts interview stakeholders and explore various aspects of your business to advise on strategic data processing solutions. The Power BI developer you hire advises on the optimized ecosystem of tools for data collection, analysis, unification, and representation. Do you need assistance in transferring your data flows to Power BI? Our developers will create the implementation plan, following industry standards and best practices.

<02>

Data Analytics & Integration

Your Power BI developers can connect data from various sources and formats. So, whether you store information in a cloud or on-premises, keep it in Excel files or an ERP, it’s easy to import, model, and visualize it in tables, maps, graphs, or charts. Analytics experts will customize calculations and add elements to help you get insights.

<03>

Power BI Mobile Intelligence

A Microsoft Power BI developer will help your team view data from their smartphones and tablets, too. Access on the go will let all the collaborators get instant updates, while live dashboards will decrease your time-to-insight. With limited internet access, users can still see previously viewed reports offline. Also, a Power BI Mobile expert will protect your data through authentication and access controls.

<04>

Power BI Reports & Dashboards

Hire remote Power BI developers to get a 360 view of your business. When you want a real-time snapshot, this expert will customize a dashboard with highlights. You can click on the stats and access related reports to explore details. Power BI can build reports with performance analysis of your sales, HR, financial, and digital marketing teams. So, you can display plenty of data with a few clicks.

<05>

Power BI Predictive Analysis

Once you possess datasets of historical data, a Power BI developer will allow you to detect patterns and predict future trends. For instance, they can estimate demand for your product by adding external parameters and choosing a suitable ML algorithm. A professional will know whether clustering, linear regression, or decision trees will deliver more accurate results and be able to evaluate the model’s performance.

<06>

Power BI Managed Services & Support

When you hire Power BI developers for managed services and support, you get a whole pack of services. They include analysis of your data structure, data acquisition and modeling, report creation, developing integrations with external services, etc. Within this scope of services, your dedicated or part-time programmers also deliver tech support for your BI platforms, run updates, and create backups.

Get more actionable insights from your data with Mobilunity’s Power BI developers!

Hire a dedicated team or a part-time developer to enhance your business performance with Power BI.

Get in touch

{cooperation models}

Our Cooperation Models

Dedicated Power BI Developer

Once you require one or several Power BI developers to work on your solution for 8 hours a day, select this format. We arrange the working environment and full back-office support for your team. You get control over the developers as over your internal team and only pay a monthly fixed fee. You’ll set tasks, manage schedules, and get feedback from your team members. 

Hire a Dedicated Power BI Developer

FLEX Power BI Developer

When you require only a few hours of Power BI expert assistance per week, part-time cooperation will be ideal. This way, you can hire an expert to supervise your project or enhance your BI team. You won’t need to pay for the office, equipment, or other overheads for your Power BI developer; you’ll only pay for the hours worked.

Hire FLEX POWER BI DEVELOPER

{benefits}

Benefits of Working with Mobilunity

Access to a Large Talent Pool

Mobilunity’s recruiters find tech experts all around the globe for 10+ years. They’ve created their own talent pools and grown a vast network of partners. This means we can find a Power BI developer remote with any skill set and make it faster than our competitors. Also, our specialists will select the candidate who fits your working environment.

Affordable Pricing

The Mobilunity’s team works in countries hosting emerging and seasoned IT hubs. Often, these countries are nearshore and offshore destinations, like Eastern Europe, Asia, and Latin America. There, you can hire Power BI developer 2-3 times cheaper than in the US, Canada, or Western Europe. So, we offer customers affordable pricing.

Effective Strategies

For over a decade of recruiting, we’ve worked out approaches to finding your best-match technicians. They include regular communication with experts, maintaining developers’ databases, and promoting vacancies on top platforms. Also, Mobilunity’s recruiters will analyze marketing trends to craft an appealing job description to hire dedicated Power BI developer for you.

Smooth Communication

During the recruiting process and further cooperation, our team ensures proactive but not annoying communication. This approach applies to critical processes like confirming the budget for hiring your Power BI developer and non-urgent issues. For instance, we’ll message you when the first CVs are ready or offer you to join an interview.

How to Hire a Power BI Developer with Mobilunity

{01}

Determine Your Needs

Think of how many Power BI developers you’ll need and which cooperation format you prefer. Also, consider deadlines and available budgets.

{02}

Get in Touch With Us Using the Form Below

Write your answers in the web form below, and we’ll return to discuss your requirements. Our managers will advise on the optimized team composition and approximate terms if you need recommendations.  

{03}

Receive Estimate and Offer From Us

We’ll spend a few days analyzing the market for your query and assessing the costs for your team. Once you accept our offer, Mobiunity’s recruiters will start advertising your vacancies.

{04}

Interviewing Candidates

As we get CVs, our recruiters will pre-screen candidates and run HR and tech interviews. This stage ends when you finalize the list of the Power BI experts.

{05}

Start Your Cooperation

Once your candidates sign cooperation offers, we prepare all the documents and onboard them. From that moment, your cooperation with the new team starts.

start the process

FAQs on Hiring Power BI Developers

Can you find qualified Power BI developers?

Yes, the Power BI experts we hire for you will have from 3 to 5 years of experience. This way, we ensure your programmers are highly qualified in data collection, analysis, and visualization. They create interactive reports and custom dashboards that deliver critical information. These specialists will optimize the Power BI solution for your business needs.

Can you provide support for Power BI developer technical interviews?

Yes, we specialize in offering support for Power BI developer technical interviews for an additional fee. We arrange interviews with leading experts in Power BI, perfect for teams requiring deep insights and expertise in business intelligence and data visualization. After the interview, you will receive a detailed report and feedback from the interviewer, aiding your decision-making process.

How will a Power BI engineer help my business?

If you accumulate information for critical reports from various sources, with the Power BI platform, you can do that faster and more effectively. Interactive dashboards and real-time reports will let you get actionable insights immediately. A Power BI programmer will also help you understand market trends and get more value from your datasets.

How do you hire Power BI developers?

We start sourcing candidates after discussing your project requirements, budgets, and deadlines. Then, we run interviews, you select the programmers for hire, and we onboard them. Our cooperation agreement assumes you get full functional control over your team while we handle all the administrative issues.

Can Power BI developers integrate data from different sources?

Sure, the Power BI professionals we hire have 3-5 years of experience getting data from cloud-based services, flat files, and various databases. So, no matter which ERP, CRM, or other tools you use to manage your business data, our coders can integrate it. Mobilunity’s Power BI architect will extract, transform, unify, and model the data to give you its consistent representation.

What support do I get after I hire dedicated Power BI developer with you?

Your programmers will develop and maintain your Power BI solutions according to your project scope. You’ll set tasks and control your team while each member is expected to collaborate efficiently. Our managers will handle operating issues and respond to your queries once they arise. That’s because Mobilunity aims to ensure smooth collaboration that brings value to your business.
